title: Chinese scientists build 54.80 cm² methylammonium-free perovskite solar module with 22.7% efficiency
summary: Chinese researchers have developed a methylammonium-free perovskite solar cell technology using ambient-air slot-die coating and a dual-additive strategy, achieving a power conversion efficiency of 26.16%. The approach also improved operational stability, with unencapsulated devices retaining 97.76% of their initial efficiency after 1,300 hours of testing. The post Chinese scientists build 54.80 cm² methylammonium-free perovskite solar module with 22.7% efficiency appeared first on pv magazine Global .
